shard.name: 7 Days to Die
shard.description: 7 Days to Die dedicated server for voxel-based zombie survival horror sandbox.
shard.author: The Fun Pimps & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# 7 Days to Die Dedicated Server Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apt update && apt install -y curl lib32gcc-s1 ca-certificates

cd /tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/steamcmd
cd /tmp/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz "https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz"
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz

echo "Installing 7 Days to Die (App ID 294420)..."
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update 294420 validate +quit

cd /mnt/server
chmod +x 7DaysToDieServer.x86_64
echo "7 Days to Die installation completed!"
